sloka: मन्साऽपि कथम् कामम् कुर्यास्त्वम् कामवृत्तयोः ।तयोस्त्वहितयोर्नित्यम् शत्र्वोः पित्रभिधानयोः ॥२-२३-१४॥
transliteration: mansā'pi katham kāmam kuryāstvam kāmavṛttayoḥ ।tayostvahitayornityam śatrvoḥ pitrabhidhānayoḥ ॥2-23-14॥

translations.english: As both of them are steeped in passion, they never thought of your wellbeing. How will you fulfil the wishes of these enemies miscalled parents?
